rules.title: Agricultural project eligibility
rules.logic: Project must implement climate-smart agricultural practices. Eligible activities include agroforestry, improved crop management, and soil carbon sequestration.

rules.title: Project design and description
rules.logic: PDD must describe farming system, baseline practices, intervention activities, and monitoring approach per GS-VER2 requirements.

rules.title: Environmental and social safeguards
rules.logic: Project must assess and mitigate environmental and social risks. Stakeholder consultation required per GS4GG safeguards framework.

rules.title: Baseline scenario determination
rules.logic: Baseline is the continuation of current agricultural practices. Stratified sampling approach used to determine baseline soil carbon stocks and emissions.

rules.title: Additionality demonstration
rules.logic: Additionality through barrier analysis and investment analysis. Must demonstrate practices exceed business-as-usual adoption rates.

rules.title: Emission reduction quantification
rules.logic: Net emission reductions = baseline emissions - project emissions. Includes soil carbon stock changes, N2O reductions, and biomass changes.

rules.title: Uncertainty analysis
rules.logic: Uncertainty must be quantified at 90% confidence interval. If uncertainty exceeds 15%, conservative deduction applied.

rules.title: Monitoring plan requirements
rules.logic: Monitoring plan must cover soil carbon sampling, crop management records, and safeguard indicator tracking per GS monitoring guidelines.

rules.title: Data quality and QA/QC
rules.logic: All measurements must follow GS-approved sampling protocols. QA/QC plan must include field duplicate analysis and lab intercomparison.

rules.title: SDG contribution assessment
rules.logic: Project must demonstrate contribution to at least three SDGs. Focus on SDG 2 (Zero Hunger), SDG 13 (Climate Action), SDG 15 (Life on Land).
